war_summary: War 139 is on day 101-102 with no winner. Colonials hold a commanding strategic lead (approx. 175 bases to Wardens' 65) across 40 regions. The hottest combat zones are Callahans Passage, Endless Shore, Callums Cape, Marban Hollow, Oarbreaker, and Clahstra, where both factions are suffering thousands of casualties per hour with accelerating trends and active base flipping. Callahans Passage and Endless Shore show the highest intensity (1,500-1,700 casualties/hr per side) with recent capture events. Callums Cape has seen a sudden massive spike (1,000+ casualties/hr) in the last 2 hours. Oarbreaker leads in event volume (52 events/24h) with rapid base turnover. Clahstra and Marban Hollow also show high, accelerating casualties and multiple recent captures. Godcrofts and Mooring County have moderate activity with recent flips. The Wardens hold quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Speaking Woods, Reaching Trail) but face heavy pressure in Speaking Woods. Large Colonial rear areas (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, etc.) are quiet.
